items.name: Readability
items.evidence: One added line that calls the existing get_initial_alias(), with a short comment, '# Ensure base table is in aliases.', explaining why. It matches the surrounding style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing query.get_initial_alias() helper and keeps the change inside single_alias. Nothing is duplicated, no dead code is left behind, and Collector/QuerySet.delete are untouched. Identical to the reference fix.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: A minimal fix with no error-handling surface and no magic constants. It runs inside a cached_property, so it executes once per compiler. All hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: Fixes the root cause in single_alias by registering the base alias before counting. The agent checked that .all().delete() now gives 'DELETE FROM "delete_user"' while a filter across the avatar join still uses the pk IN subquery. The MySQL compiler benefits too.
